# Mars Corporation

> Daily AI-assisted intelligence on Mars corporation: strategy, investments, ESG and innovations.

Content is in English. Articles are collected nightly from public RSS feeds of pet food trade publications; summaries and the daily briefing are AI-generated, and each item links to its original source.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/mars/): articles of the last 30 days with the daily briefing
- [Archive](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/mars/archive/index.html): one page per month, all articles

## Machine-readable

- [Atom feed](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/mars/feed.xml): 50 latest articles
- [JSON data](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/mars/data.json): briefing and articles from the last 30 days
- [Sitemap](https://ibmphilippecabel.github.io/industry-watch/mars/sitemap.xml)

## Categories

- 🤝 Mars Corporate & M&A
- 🐾 Petcare & Royal Canin
- 🍫 Snacking & FMCG Market
- ⚡ Tech & Operations
- 🌱 Sustainability & Sourcing

## Sources

- [Mars & Brands Watch (Google News)](https://www.mars.com): Actualités mondiales, M&A (Kellanova), nominations et stratégie de marque.
- [Petfood Industry](https://www.petfoodindustry.com/): Marché Petcare, nutrition, investissements industriels et concurrence.
- [Food Dive](https://www.fooddive.com/): Tendances CPG, snacking, acquisitions et stratégies des géants de l'alimentation.
- [Mars Snacking & Brands (Google News)](https://www.mars.com/our-brands/mars-wrigley): Chocolat, confiserie, snacking, Kellanova, Pringles et packaging.
- [Consumer Goods Technology](https://www.consumergoods.com/): IA, transformation digitale, ERP/Supply Chain et e-commerce appliqués au FMCG.
- [ESG Today](https://www.esgtoday.com/): Décarbonation, agriculture régénératrice, emballages durables et conformité ESG.
